facts.fact: The organic law 2024-22 provides that the national ID card carries an electronic authentication certificate allowing identity verification and creation of an electronic signature, with existing cards replaced by chip cards under a renewal programme set by ministerial order.

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior specialized services

facts.fact: The law requires administrative services to inform the national security directorate of a cardholder's death within thirty days, whereupon the card chip is deactivated, and requires civil-status changes to be notified for the card within 90 days of entry in the civil register.
